model: Ache et al. 2019 GF input model, equations 3-7
methods_locator: STAR Methods, GF Model, pages e3-e4, equations (3)-(7)
paper_output: Subthreshold GF membrane-potential change, not spike rate
angle_convention: Full angular diameter in degrees, not half-angle or radians
assumptions: Published fitted component weights are retained; they are not MaleCNS synapse counts.
I1 is independent of LC4/LPLC2; I2 is LC4-dependent, so LC4 silencing removes both LC4 and I2.
Original experimental recordings and ModelDB implementation were not downloaded; validation is an equation reimplementation and qualitative replication, not a new fit to raw recordings.
Any spike/action threshold in the optional physical adapter is an engineering parameter outside the paper model.
